BiblicalUsage: Sheva is the father of Machbenah and Gibea, named among the sons of Caleb in the genealogy of Judah. The name also belongs to David's scribe, whose spelling differs by a single letter, and the two Shevas are kept apart by their verses.
TheologicalSignificance: A name in a genealogy is never wasted ink; it is a man God counted, and I am glad He counts men I would pass over.
